name: numbers-native
description: Create, read and edit native Apple Numbers documents through Numbers on macOS. No Excel conversion.

interface.longDescription: Native Apple Numbers documents, formulas, compatible formats and guided charts. Guarded multi-table edits, native-result checks and typed CSV/TSV append/upsert. File-pair backup/restore/move, PDF/PNG previews and local diagnostics. Requires macOS, Numbers and Node.js 22+. No Accessibility or Excel conversion.
defaultPrompt: Create a native Numbers document with a budget and working formulas.
Read and update a Numbers table while preserving its native document.
